About

I grew up in Franca, Brazil, and now live in Valencia, Spain.

I’ve been writing software professionally since 2019, all of it remote. For four and a half years I was the only frontend engineer on Spaceship’s domain search at Namecheap. I built it from scratch and owned everything from architecture to releases: real-time pricing over WebSockets for 500+ TLDs, bulk search, and pricing in 30+ currencies. It sold more than 3 million domains while I was there.

Now I’m building SetLuca, a DM sales platform for experts, creators and coaches. It reads incoming DMs on Instagram, Messenger and Telegram, scores each lead and replies in the creator’s own voice. It’s TypeScript end to end: Hono on Cloudflare Workers, Inngest, TanStack Start, PostgreSQL and Drizzle.

On the side I build Strait, background jobs and multi-step workflows that run on the Postgres database you already have, with no Redis or separate queue. It’s a single Go binary, open source under Apache-2.0.

In 2018 I published 33 JavaScript Concepts as a study guide for myself. It now has 66K stars and translations in 40+ languages, and GitHub named it one of the top projects of 2018. I still maintain it.

I’ve also written 100+ articles on React, TypeScript and frontend performance for LogRocket and Progress. I like explaining things clearly and helping other developers learn.

I mostly work in TypeScript, front and back, and I like owning a product from the first architecture decision to every release.

Outside of work I walk around Valencia, read, and start side projects that sometimes ship. I speak Portuguese and English, and some Spanish.

I’m open to senior full-stack and freelance roles, remote or partly on-site in Europe. If you want to talk, email me.
